lines.speaker: Announcer
lines.text: Between putting out fires in downtown, narrowly saving hundreds from a potential plane crash, and stopping bank robbers single-handedly, Satan City, and maybe Earth itself, has found a new hero.

lines.speaker: Sharpner
lines.text: Oh my god, is 'The' part of his name? What is he, a rapper?

lines.speaker: Videl
lines.text: It is a weird name for a superhero.

lines.speaker: Sharpner
lines.text: Of course you do, you're hillfolk.

lines.speaker: Sharpner
lines.text: Erasa, he knows I love him. Gohan, you know I love you.

lines.speaker: Videl
lines.text: A superhuman wannabe hero enforcing his justice on my city.

lines.speaker: Erasa
lines.text: Unlike you, who enforces your justice on your dad's city.

lines.speaker: Videl
lines.text: He's working outside of the law.

lines.speaker: Erasa
lines.text: Oh, and that makes you the good guy?

lines.speaker: Erasa
lines.text: It means you're my favorite nepo baby, Videl, and I love you.
